title: Build a Fidget Toy
prompt:
Build a fidget toy — something to poke, drag, spin, flick, or squish.

One `index.html` file. No score, no goal, no instructions: someone who lands on it should be playing with it within a second and not want to stop.

Mouse and touch both. Keep it silent — builds get played side by side. Make the feel of it your whole focus: the weight, the bounce, the snap-back.

People vote on these and pick the one they'd rather keep open. The obvious version loses — make it yours.

You're done when you catch yourself still fiddling with it after you meant to stop.
